title: Trigger generation after submission creation
description:
Wire the create-submission UX into the AI generation workflow.

Why:
The current form creates a submission and returns to the submissions list. The next phase needs creation to kick off viva generation and keep the teacher informed while it runs.

Work:
- update the create flow so generation is triggered after the submission is saved
- choose a user flow that keeps the teacher oriented, likely redirecting to the submission detail page with a visible loading state
- preserve clear feedback for submission-create failures versus generation failures
- ensure the generated result appears without forcing a confusing manual refresh path

Acceptance criteria:
- creating a submission starts generation for that submission
- the user sees a clear loading state while waiting for the questions
- success and failure outcomes are routed into the submission detail experience cleanly

title: Add submission detail page with generated viva output
description:
Create a dedicated submission detail route at `/submissions/{id}`.

Why:
Teachers need a stable place to read the full submission alongside the generated viva questions and scoring output.

Work:
- add a route and data-loading path for a single submission by id
- render the submission title, student, full text, and creation metadata
- render generated viva output when available, including categories, teacher notes, score breakdown, strengths, and next steps
- render appropriate empty/loading/error states when generation has not finished or has failed

Acceptance criteria:
- a teacher can open `/submissions/{id}` and read the submission in full
- generated viva output is shown on the same page when available
- the page handles in-progress and failed generation states clearly

title: Generate viva analysis with AI SDK
description:
Implement the server-side generation pipeline for submission viva analysis.

Why:
After a submission is created, its text must be sent to an LLM using the provided KS4 prompt and returned in a structured format that can be stored safely.

Work:
- use the AI SDK for the generation call
- encode the provided prompt and output contract into a server-side interface
- validate and normalize model output before persistence
- persist generated questions, score data, and teacher guidance against the submission
- record generation failures without losing the underlying submission

Acceptance criteria:
- given a persisted submission, the app can request an AI viva analysis and save the result
- malformed or incomplete model output is handled explicitly rather than silently accepted
- failures are stored in a way the UI can surface and recover from later

title: Persist submission viva analyses and questions
description:
Add the database model for generated viva output attached to a submission.

Why:
The app currently stores submissions only. To support LLM-generated teacher questions and scoring, we need a stable persistence model keyed to a submission.

Work:
- decide the storage shape for a generated analysis, including foreign keys back to submissions
- store the 12 generated questions with category and teacher note data
- store the writing score, category breakdown, strengths, next steps, teacher guidance, and generation status/error metadata
- add the required migrations, indexes, and row-level security policies for authenticated reads/writes

Acceptance criteria:
- a submission can have generated viva data persisted and queried later
- the schema supports loading, success, and failure states for generation
- the persistence model is documented clearly enough for frontend and server work to build against it

title: Generate AI viva analysis for submissions
description:
Build the next phase of the submissions feature so each submission can be analysed by an LLM, persisted, and reviewed by a teacher.

Scope:
- generate a structured viva output from a submission using the provided KS4 prompt
- persist generated questions, score breakdown, guidance, and generation state against a submission
- add a submission detail page that shows the full submission and generated output
- update the submission creation flow so generation is triggered after create and the UI reflects in-progress work

Success looks like:
- a teacher can open a submission and review generated viva questions and scoring guidance
- generation is tracked in the data model and UI with clear loading/error/success states
- the implementation is split into small tasks that can be worked asynchronously

title: Rename remaining vivas artifacts to submissions
description: Clean up file names, component names, and tests left over from the vivas-to-submissions rename so the codebase consistently reflects submissions terminology only where it now represents submissions functionality.

title: Add submission links and generation status to the submissions list
description:
Update the submissions list so teachers can find and revisit generated viva analyses easily.

Why:
Once submissions gain their own detail pages and generation status, the list page needs to expose those entry points and states.

Work:
- link each submission row or card to its detail page
- expose generation status in the list UI so teachers can see whether analysis is pending, ready, or failed
- keep the list behavior aligned with the detail-page data model

Acceptance criteria:
- each submission in the list links to its detail page
- the list makes generation state visible at a glance
- the list remains usable while some submissions are still generating or have generation failures

title: Build new submission form on submissions/new
description: Implement the new submission creation form on the authenticated submissions/new page. The first version should collect a title and long-form submission text, show advisory word count guidance around 400 words, use the CTA label 'Generate viva questions', create the submission record only, and redirect back to the submissions list after success. Follow TDD for the route, mutation, and UI behavior.

title: Gate deploy workflow on tests
description: Update the current GitHub Actions deploy workflow so the new test suite runs and must pass before deployment proceeds.
close_reason: Updated the Cloudflare deploy workflow to require the test job to pass before deployment.

title: Add initial Vitest test skeleton
description: Add a minimal Vitest setup, script, and first simple test so the repository has a working starting point for test coverage.
close_reason: Added a minimal Vitest skeleton with root and app scripts plus a first passing unit test.
